meta.name: Publish weekly AI social videos with Airtable, Claude, Sora, Cloudinary, and Buffer

name: Weekly AI Social Video — Airtable + Claude + Sora + Buffer

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger Reels
nodes.notes: Runs once a week, Monday at 17:00 (workflow timezone). Change day/hour here.

nodes.name: Get Reel Ideas
nodes.notes: Reads every row from the 'Topics' table where Active = TRUE. This is your idea bank: one topic per row in a field called 'Topic'.

nodes.name: Check History Reels
nodes.notes: Fetches the last 14 published reels (sorted by Date, newest first). Used to avoid repeating a topic too soon. 'Always output data' is ON so an empty table does not stop the run.

nodes.name: Filter and Choose Reel Topic
nodes.notes: Compares the idea bank against the last 14 published reels, keeps only the topics that were NOT used recently and picks one at random. Outputs { topic, isValid }.

nodes.name: Is Valid Reel?
nodes.notes: TRUE branch = a fresh topic was found, continue. FALSE branch = every topic was already used in the last 14 runs, stop safely.

nodes.name: Claude - Write Post Text1
nodes.notes: Calls the Anthropic Messages API and writes a short video caption for the chosen topic. EDIT THE PROMPT INSIDE THE JSON BODY: replace the brand context, tone of voice and rules with your own.

parameters.jsonBody:

nodes.name: Put Text in Variable1
nodes.notes: Extracts the plain text out of the Anthropic API response and stores it as 'postText', so later nodes can reference it cleanly.

nodes.name: Generate a video
nodes.notes: Generates a vertical 720x1280 video clip (Sora) from the chosen topic. Edit the prompt to match your own visual style. Note: video generation takes a while and is the most expensive step.

parameters.prompt: =A premium 3D motion graphics animation in a modern tech SaaS aesthetic, 720x1280 vertical aspect ratio, perfect for Instagram Reels loop. VISUAL SCENE: Dynamic and stylized 3D objects, clay-textured tech devices, and abstract geometric elements that visually represent and match the topic: '{{ $('Is Valid Reel?').item.json.topic }}'. BACKGROUND & MOVEMENT: A clean, minimalist soft lavender-grey and white infinite digital workspace. Vibrant purple (#6C54F7) neon light streams and glossy abstract shapes pulse, float, and morph smoothly in the center of the screen. The camera does a very subtle, elegant zoom-in. CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS: Absolutely NO text, NO typography, and NO letters anywhere on the screen. Focus purely on clean, high-end 3D symbolic and abstract visuals. No real human faces, no photorealism, high-end clean render style.

nodes.name: Upload Reel to Cloudinary
nodes.notes: Uploads the generated video file to Cloudinary and returns a public URL, which the social APIs need. Any public file host works here.

nodes.name: Create LinkedIn Video
nodes.notes: Sends caption + video URL to Buffer for the LinkedIn channel. Fill in your own Buffer organization ID and channel ID.

nodes.name: Create Instagram Reel
nodes.notes: Sends the same caption + video URL to Buffer for the Instagram channel. Fill in your own Buffer organization ID and channel ID.

nodes.name: Log Posted Reel
nodes.notes: Writes topic and caption to the 'Reels' table. This is what makes the 14-day anti-repeat memory work, so do not remove it.

parameters.content:
## 1. Pick a fresh topic
Loads your active topics and the last 14 published reels, then randomly picks one that was not used recently. If every topic has been used, the run stops instead of repeating itself.

## 2. Generate the content
Claude writes a short video caption, then Sora renders a vertical 720x1280 clip for that same topic.

## 3. Publish and remember
Cloudinary turns the video into a public URL, Buffer schedules it on LinkedIn and Instagram, and Airtable logs it as next week's memory.

## 🗂️ Airtable setup

Create one base with these tables. Both the daily-post and the weekly-video version of this workflow can share the same base.

**Topics** — your idea bank
| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `Topic` | Single line text |
| `Active` | Checkbox |

Only checked rows are used. Fill it with 20-40 ideas; the workflow picks one at random per run.

**Reels** — the history it remembers
| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `Date` | Created time |
| `Topic` | Single line text |
| `Post` | Long text |

⚠️ `Date` must be a **Created time** field, not a normal date. The workflow never writes it, but it sorts on it to find the last 14 items. Without it the anti-repeat check silently breaks.

**How the anti-repeat works:** active topics minus the last 14 logged rows = the pool it picks from. Empty pool means the run stops instead of repeating content, so keep 15+ topics active.

Posts and reels use separate history tables, so the same topic can run as an image post and as a video without blocking each other.

## 🎬 Weekly AI Video & Reel Engine

Once a week this workflow picks a topic it has not used recently, writes a caption with Claude, generates a vertical AI video, and schedules it to LinkedIn and Instagram through Buffer.

### How it works
1. The schedule trigger fires weekly (Monday 17:00).
2. Airtable returns your active topics plus the last 14 published reels.
3. A Code node randomly picks a topic that is not in that history, so content never repeats.
4. Claude writes the caption and Sora renders a 720x1280 vertical clip.
5. Cloudinary hosts the file and returns the public URL that the social APIs require.
6. Buffer schedules the video and Airtable logs it as the memory for next week.

### Setup
1. Create credentials for Airtable, Anthropic, OpenAI, Buffer and Cloudinary.
2. Build the Airtable base described in the grey note below this one.
3. Pick your organization and channel from the dropdowns in both Buffer nodes.
4. Keep at least 15 active topics, otherwise the workflow stops instead of repeating itself.

### Customization
Edit the prompt in *Generate a video* to match your own visual style, and the Claude prompt for your tone of voice. Video generation is the slowest and most expensive step, which is why this runs weekly rather than daily.

nodes.name: No Operation, do nothing
nodes.notes: Dead end on purpose: nothing is published when no fresh topic is available. Add more rows to the Topics table (or a Slack/Email node here) if you want an alert.
